caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug with a fringe along its borders, primarily in shades of green. There is a stylized image of a black animal, resembling a cat or dog, positioned lengthwise on the rug. The animal has four visible legs with paws colored in a yellowish-brown hue, accents of light brown on the body, and a tail curled alongside its body. Its face is characterized by a blue eye, a pink triangular ear, and a small pink mouth. One corner of the rug at the upper right is turned over, revealing the underside, which is tan with a dark green border. The entire rug, including its fringed edges, occupies the center of the composition, and the drawing is on an off-white or beige background.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
